# 2:20 Partners Design & Construction PLC

> Design-build firm in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, founded in 2012 by architect Samson Getachew and contractor Beniam Tilahun. Architecture, construction, interior fit-out, site supervision and custom joinery (2:20 Woodworks), delivered by one accountable team.

- Office: Megenagna, near Shola Market and the Ring Road, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
- Phone: +251 93 717 4816
- Email: 220partnersplc@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00
- Areas served: Addis Ababa (Bole, Sarbet, CMC, Ayat, Old Airport, Kazanchis, Megenagna) and wider Ethiopia
- Languages: English, Amharic (አማርኛ)
- Experience: 14+ years, 50+ completed projects
- First step: free consultation and site visit, then a written feasibility budget

- [2:20 Woodworks](https://220partnersplc.com/woodworks/): custom kitchens, walk-in closets, vanities, doors, built-ins and furniture in Ethiopian hardwoods (Tid, Wanza, Zigba, Tikur Inchet)

## How a project works
1. Discover — free consultation, site visit, brief, budget and timeline
2. Design — concept sketches, plans, 3D renderings, material palette
3. Document — construction drawings, structural and MEP, Addis Ababa building permits
4. Build — in-house crews under daily site supervision
5. Hand over — snag list, walkthrough, defect-liability period, as-built drawings

## Typical timelines
- Custom homes: 12–18 months from sign-off
- Mid-rise commercial: 18–30 months
- Interior fit-outs: 8–14 weeks
